#ifndef TITLE_ID
#define TITLE_ID VDEC10003
#endif
#ifndef TITLE_NAME
#define TITLE_NAME Fresh_Native_Build
#endif
#define STRINGIFY_(value) #value
#define STRINGIFY(value) STRINGIFY_(value)
#define SOURCE "/user/appmeta/" STRINGIFY(TITLE_ID)
#define TARGET "/system_ex/app/" STRINGIFY(TITLE_ID)

#define IOVEC_ENTRY(value) {(void *)(value), (value) ? strlen(value) + 1 : 0}
#define IOVEC_SIZE(value) (sizeof(value) / sizeof(struct iovec))

typedef struct notify_request {
    char reserved[45];
    char message[3075];
} notify_request_t;

int sceKernelSendNotificationRequest(int, notify_request_t *, size_t, int);

static void notify(const char *message)
{
    notify_request_t request = {0};
    snprintf(request.message, sizeof(request.message), "%s", message);
    (void)sceKernelSendNotificationRequest(0, &request, sizeof(request), 0);
}

static const char *title_name(void)
{
    static char name[128];
    const char *encoded = STRINGIFY(TITLE_NAME);
    size_t i;
    for (i = 0; i + 1 < sizeof(name) && encoded[i] != '\0'; ++i)
        name[i] = encoded[i] == '_' ? ' ' : encoded[i];
    name[i] = '\0';
    return name;
}

int main(void)
{
    char message[256];
    snprintf(message, sizeof(message), "Mount helper: starting %s",
             title_name());
    notify(message);
    struct iovec iov[] = {
        IOVEC_ENTRY("fstype"), IOVEC_ENTRY("nullfs"),
        IOVEC_ENTRY("from"), IOVEC_ENTRY(SOURCE),
        IOVEC_ENTRY("fspath"), IOVEC_ENTRY(TARGET),
    };

    if (mkdir(TARGET, 0755) != 0 && errno != EEXIST) {
        snprintf(message, sizeof(message), "Mount helper: mkdir failed (%s)",
                 strerror(errno));
        notify(message);
        printf("mount-helper: %s\n", message);
        return 1;
    }
    if (unmount(TARGET, 0) != 0 && errno != ENOENT && errno != EINVAL) {
        snprintf(message, sizeof(message), "Mount helper: unmount failed (%s)",
                 strerror(errno));
        notify(message);
        printf("mount-helper: %s\n", message);
        return 2;
    }
    if (nmount(iov, IOVEC_SIZE(iov), 0) != 0) {
        snprintf(message, sizeof(message), "Mount helper: mount failed (%s)",
                 strerror(errno));
        notify(message);
        printf("mount-helper: %s\n", message);
        return 3;
    }
    snprintf(message, sizeof(message), "Mount helper: %s mounted",
             title_name());
    notify(message);
    printf("mount-helper: mounted %s -> %s\n", SOURCE, TARGET);
    return 0;
}

    static const char request[] =
        "GET /hbldr?path=%2Fdata%2Fhomebrew%2FVdecHello%2Feboot.elf&"
        "cwd=%2Fdata%2Fhomebrew%2FVdecHello&pipe=1 HTTP/1.0\r\n\r\n";
    char *args[] = {"websrv.elf", 0};
    struct sockaddr_in address = {0};
    int socket_fd;
    socket_fd = socket(AF_INET, SOCK_STREAM, 0);
    address.sin_family = AF_INET;
    address.sin_port = htons(8080);
    address.sin_addr.s_addr = htonl(INADDR_LOOPBACK);
    if (socket_fd < 0 || connect(socket_fd, (void *)&address,
                                 sizeof(address)) != 0) {
        if (socket_fd >= 0)
            close(socket_fd);
        if (elfldr_spawn("/data", -1, (uint8_t *)websrv_elf, args, 0) < 0)
            return -1;
        sleep(2);
        socket_fd = socket(AF_INET, SOCK_STREAM, 0);
        if (socket_fd < 0 || connect(socket_fd, (void *)&address,
                                     sizeof(address)) != 0) {
            if (socket_fd >= 0)
                close(socket_fd);
            return -1;
        }
    }
    if (write(socket_fd, request, sizeof(request) - 1) < 0) {
        close(socket_fd);
        return -1;
    }
    close(socket_fd);
    return 0;
}

#ifndef TITLE_ID
#define TITLE_ID VDEC10003
#endif
#ifndef TITLE_NAME
#define TITLE_NAME Fresh_Native_Build
#endif
#define STRINGIFY_(value) #value
#define STRINGIFY(value) STRINGIFY_(value)
#define SOURCE "/user/appmeta/" STRINGIFY(TITLE_ID)
#define TARGET "/system_ex/app/" STRINGIFY(TITLE_ID)

#define IOVEC_ENTRY(value) {(void *)(value), (value) ? strlen(value) + 1 : 0}
#define IOVEC_SIZE(value) (sizeof(value) / sizeof(struct iovec))

typedef struct notify_request {
    char reserved[45];
    char message[3075];
} notify_request_t;

int sceKernelSendNotificationRequest(int, notify_request_t *, size_t, int);

static void notify(const char *message)
{
    notify_request_t request = {0};
    snprintf(request.message, sizeof(request.message), "%s", message);
    (void)sceKernelSendNotificationRequest(0, &request, sizeof(request), 0);
}

static const char *title_name(void)
{
    static char name[128];
    const char *encoded = STRINGIFY(TITLE_NAME);
    size_t i;
    for (i = 0; i + 1 < sizeof(name) && encoded[i] != '\0'; ++i)
        name[i] = encoded[i] == '_' ? ' ' : encoded[i];
    name[i] = '\0';
    return name;
}

int main(void)
{
    char message[256];
    snprintf(message, sizeof(message), "Mount helper: starting %s",
             title_name());
    notify(message);
    struct iovec iov[] = {
        IOVEC_ENTRY("fstype"), IOVEC_ENTRY("nullfs"),
        IOVEC_ENTRY("from"), IOVEC_ENTRY(SOURCE),
        IOVEC_ENTRY("fspath"), IOVEC_ENTRY(TARGET),
    };

    if (mkdir(TARGET, 0755) != 0 && errno != EEXIST) {
        snprintf(message, sizeof(message), "Mount helper: mkdir failed (%s)",
                 strerror(errno));
        notify(message);
        printf("mount-helper: %s\n", message);
        return 1;
    }
    if (unmount(TARGET, 0) != 0 && errno != ENOENT && errno != EINVAL) {
        snprintf(message, sizeof(message), "Mount helper: unmount failed (%s)",
                 strerror(errno));
        notify(message);
        printf("mount-helper: %s\n", message);
        return 2;
    }
    if (nmount(iov, IOVEC_SIZE(iov), 0) != 0) {
        snprintf(message, sizeof(message), "Mount helper: mount failed (%s)",
                 strerror(errno));
        notify(message);
        printf("mount-helper: %s\n", message);
        return 3;
    }
    snprintf(message, sizeof(message), "Mount helper: %s mounted",
             title_name());
    notify(message);
    printf("mount-helper: mounted %s -> %s\n", SOURCE, TARGET);
    return 0;
}

    if ($LASTEXITCODE) { throw "wslpath failed for $resolved" }
    return $converted.Trim()

> #!/usr/bin/env python3
import argparse
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path


def digest(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def imm64(signature):
    raw = bytes.fromhex(signature)
    if len(raw) != 8:
        raise ValueError("runtime signatures must be exactly 8 bytes")
    return int.from_bytes(raw, "little")


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--profile", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--host", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--libkernel", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--signer", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--out", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--title-id", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--title", required=True)

    ):

    long written = ps5_kernel_write((int)fd, data, length);

    [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)] [string] $Sdk,
    [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)] [string] $HostElf,
    [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)] [string] $Libkernel,
    [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)] [string] $MakeFself,
    [string] $TitleId = "PPSA99001",
    [string] $Title = "ShadowMount Native Hello",
    [string] $App = "",
    [string] $Icon = "",
    [string] $Out = ""
)

$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"

if ($TitleId -notmatch '^PPSA99\d{3}$') {
    throw "TitleId must match PPSA99XXX, where XXX is three digits (for example PPSA99001)."
}

$project = $PSScriptRoot
if (-not $App) { $App = Join-Path $project "examples\hello.c" }
if (-not $Icon) { $Icon = Join-Path $project "assets\prism-icon.png" }
if (-not $Out) { $Out = Join-Path $project "dist\$TitleId" }

if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $Sdk -PathType Container)) {
    throw "Missing SDK directory: $Sdk"
}
foreach ($path in @($HostElf, $Libkernel, $MakeFself, $App, $Icon)) {
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $path -PathType Leaf)) {
        throw "Missing input: $path"
    }
}

$Sdk = (Resolve-Path -LiteralPath $Sdk).Path
$HostElf = (Resolve-Path -LiteralPath $HostElf).Path
$Libkernel = (Resolve-Path -LiteralPath $Libkernel).Path
$MakeFself = (Resolve-Path -LiteralPath $MakeFself).Path
$App = (Resolve-Path -LiteralPath $App).Path
$Icon = (Resolve-Path -LiteralPath $Icon).Path

if (-not (Get-Command wsl -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) {
    throw "WSL is required by the native build."
}
$wslProbe = & wsl wslpath -a (($project -replace '\\', '/') + '/build.ps1') 2>&1
if ($LASTEXITCODE) {
    throw "WSL is installed but cannot start a Linux distribution. Enable WSL and retry. Details: $wslProbe"
}

& (Join-Path $project "tools\build.ps1") `
    -Sdk $Sdk -HostElf $HostElf -Libkernel $Libkernel -MakeFself $MakeFself `
    -App $App -Title $Title -TitleId $TitleId -SkipInstaller
if ($LASTEXITCODE) { throw "Native build failed." }

$built <truncated omitted_approx_tokens="76" />in-Path $outPath "sce_sys\param.json") -Force
Copy-Item -LiteralPath $Icon -Destination (Join-Path $outPath "sce_sys\icon0.png") -Force

$paramPath = Join-Path $outPath "sce_sys\param.json"
$param = Get-Content -Raw -LiteralPath $paramPath | ConvertFrom-Json
if ($param.titleId -ne $TitleId -or
    $param.applicationCategoryType -ne 65536 -or
    $param.contentBadgeType -ne 2) {
    throw "Output metadata is not ShadowMountPlus Media-compatible."
}
foreach ($path in @((Join-Path $outPath "eboot.bin"), $paramPath,
                    (Join-Path $outPath "sce_sys\icon0.png"))) {
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $path -PathType Leaf)) {
        throw "Output validation failed: $path"
    }
}

Write-Host "Ready for FTP: $outPath"

param(
    [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)] [string] $Sdk,
    [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)] [string] $HostElf,
    [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)] [string] $Libkernel,
    [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)] [string] $MakeFself,
    [string] $App,
    [string] $Title = "ShadowMount Native Hello",
    [string] $TitleId = "PPSA99001",
    [switch] $SkipInstaller
)

$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"
$root = Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot
if (-not $App) { $App = Join-Path $root "examples\hello.c" }

function Convert-ToWslPath([string] $Path) {
    $resolved = (Resolve-Path -LiteralPath $Path).Path
    $converted = & wsl wslpath -a ($resolved -replace '\\', '/')
    if ($LASTEXITCODE) { throw "wslpath failed for $resolved" }
    return $converted.Trim()
}

$arguments = @(
    "bash", (Convert-ToWslPath (Join-Path $root "build.sh")),
    "--sdk", (Convert-ToWslPath $Sdk),
    "--host", (Convert-ToWslPath $HostElf),
    "--libkernel", (Convert-ToWslPath $Libkernel),
    "--make-fself", (Convert-ToWslPath $MakeFself),
    "--app", (Convert-ToWslPath $App),
      "--title-id", $TitleId,
      "--title", $Title
  )
  if ($SkipInstaller) { $arguments += "--skip-installer" }
& wsl @arguments
if ($LASTEXITCODE) { throw "build failed" }

def int_with_base_type(val):
	return int(val, 0)

	try:
		return int(x, base) if isinstance(x, str) else int(x)
	except:

def align_up(x, alignment):
	return (x + (alignment - 1)) & ~(alignment - 1)

def align_down(x, alignment):
	return x & ~(alignment - 1)

def ilog2(x):

	if not os.access(val, os.F_OK | os.R_OK) or not os.path.isfile(val):

		raise argparse.ArgumentTypeError('invalid output file: {0}'.format(val))
	return val

	return new_val
